title: Exact computation of loop averages in two-dimensional Yang-Mills theory
note: Phys. Rev. D 22(12) (1980), 3090-3103. Verified via Crossref REST API (DOI 10.1103/PhysRevD.22.3090) and OpenAlex abstract (2026-11-28). Formulates and applies the non-abelian surface Stokes theorem expressing path-ordered Wilson loop holonomies around partial S as surface-ordered exponentials of parallel-transported curvature (Section II), yielding exact entangled loop expectations in 2d Yang-Mills gauge theory (Sections III-IV); physics precursor to Yekutieli (2015).
